* The cost of the worst possible single operation is at most |V|, since a vertex with |V| outgoing edges has a cost of |V|.

The average amortized cost of the above sequence of operations based on aggregate analysis is |V|.

* This is because the total cost of all operations is equal to the sum of the costs of all vertices, which is equal to the number of edges in the graph.
* The average cost of each operation is therefore equal to the total cost divided by the number of operations, which is equal to the number of edges divided by the number of vertices, or |E|/|V|.
